items.title: THE MOST KREATIVE LOCAL AI KING IS HERE! KREA 2 IS A BEAST!
items.summary:
RIP Z-IMAGE TURBO! A NEW IMAGE AI KING IS HERE!
KREA 2 is a brand new image generation model with incredible realism, beautiful artistic styles, strong prompt following and some of the best aesthetics I have seen from an open model so far! KREA 2 completely destroys Z-image when it comes to image quality, creativity and style. It is also so impressive that it can even go toe-to-toe with Ideogram 4 all while having a much better community license and more than 5 times the generation speed.

In this video, I show you how to install KREA 2 in 1 click, how to run it locally and compare it directly against Z-Image Turbo and Ideogram 4, and why by the end of this video you will love this model!

items.title: AI Gets Rewarded For Lying To You
items.summary:
It's really interesting how Dan Klein thinks about hallucinations.

His argument: every output from an LLM is technically a hallucination; some just happen to be right.

No LLM ever knows whether its answer is right, where the information came from, or how reliable it is.

So every answer your AI gives you is probably just a bet.
